summary_override: Proved: A183161(n) mod 4 is the output of a six-state automaton on the binary digits of n with outputs 0, 1, 2; the value 3 never occurs.
notes: Same proof as OEIS-A183161 (Lagrange inversion, S = sqrt((1-3t)/(1+t)) = 1+2W mod 4, six-state Rowland-Yassawi automaton over Z/4). Lean: A218622_ne_three via OpenProblemsLib.HannaMod4.A183161_def_mod4; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: the existence of the integer sequence A183161 (the OEIS terms); the theorem covers every integer sequence with b(0) = 1 and self-convolution A183160.
